profile: Travel professional who plans, books and runs group and private trips, and stays the one calm contact while they run.

bullets: Itineraries: about 30 private and small-group trips a year, from three-day city breaks to two-week tours with several stops.
Bookings: hotels, ferries, coaches, licensed guides and domestic flights, each confirmed in writing and reconfirmed before arrival.
On the road: the single contact for clients and suppliers throughout each trip, by phone and messaging, seven days a week.
Changes: rebooks ferries, rooms and transfers the same day when weather, strikes or delays cancel a leg of the route.
Trip packs: a day-by-day plan with addresses, contacts, transfer times and confirmations, sent a week before departure.
experience.intro: Independent agency for private and small-group travel in Greece and abroad.

bullets: Passenger desk: bookings, seat changes and baggage claims by phone and at the counter, on two reservation systems.
Disruptions: rerouted passengers onto partner flights during cancellations, and arranged hotels for missed connections.

education_entries.institution: Example School of Tourism Professions, continuing education

availability.text: Seasonal or year-round contracts, at two weeks’ notice; happy to travel with groups for up to three weeks.
